nodes.npcLine: A cloaked figure steps from the shadows. 'I am the Keeper of Secrets. Few know the hidden ways of this library as I do.'
'The library is riddled with doors unseen, stairs that lead where none expect. Some paths are safer than others… but all demand courage.'
'His chambers lie at the tower’s peak, hidden behind a secret door in the Serapeum. But beware — Hypatia guards the way, and she will test you before you may pass.'

options.playerLine: Ask if there is another way.

nodes.npcLine: The Keeper leans closer. 'Some say the Garden of Muses holds paths not marked on any map. But secrets are best discovered, not spoken aloud.'
The Keeper fades back into the shadows. 'Farewell, seeker. May the hidden ways reveal themselves to you.'
